compatibility.note: A limited jQuery API adapter preserves these original pages without running the full jQuery library inside the Roblox JavaScript VM.

imageCaveats: Browser previews use the unchanged original image files.
Roblox uses the separate ImageCatalog pixel/SVG bridge rather than published asset IDs.
Pixel dimensions, frame selection, and image resampling limits are documented by the image pack manifest; publication does not claim native Roblox visual parity.
DeepWiki declares Arial as its Roblox default font because its original CSS font stack is unavailable; the original CSS remains unchanged. Other sites have no publisher font override.
differences: Stable .ann aliases are port configuration; the original game generates domains per save.
Page host bridge replaces the original Unity-native JS hooks.
Source image pixels are supplied by the separate ImageCatalog port.

All three Wiki templates display fixed disjoint rosters of 20 real and 10 fake sites plus the other two Wikis, covering all60 real sites. The original game chooses15 real and10 fake entries per Wiki in a randomized save.
Original confession services are answered offline and never submit visitor text.
TheThree puzzle.js has one missing selector closing bracket repaired; puzzle order and reset rules remain original.
